title: Context service usage-log entry (#348)
description: One append-only JSON line per successfully answered /basis, /context, /search or /documents request, written only when the brain's context-host config declares `usageLog` AND the operator supplies a sink (scripts/context_http.py). Deliberately narrow: no record content (title/text/data), no caller identity beyond its declared policy `kind` (audienceClass). `additionalProperties: false` throughout is the structural enforcement of that boundary, not documentation of it.

time.description: The host clock at the moment this entry was recorded (context_host's trusted `now`, not client input).

operation.description: The four served routes, plus `cite` for a consumer-reported citation (scripts/context_feedback.py).

policyScope.description: The knowledge-policy scope id declaring this log's retention/access (host config `usageLog.scope`); look up its `rules.readers`/`rules.retentionDays` in the pinned policy, never duplicated here since policy can change after this entry is written.

audienceClass.description: The authenticated principal's policy-declared kind, never the principal itself.

scope.description: The record's own `scope` field (which brain/component compiled it), not this request's scopes.
